description: Infrastructure + shared data contract + documentation foundation for DocMind. Creates docker-compose (Postgres+pgvector with the CREATE EXTENSION init SQL and service placeholders for both app services), the canonical JSON block schema document that BOTH services implement verbatim, the root README, and monorepo-matching secret/ignore files (.env.example committed, .gitignore). This is the shared ground FEAT-002 (Python) and FEAT-003 (Java) both reference; it must land first.
steps: Create docmind/docker-compose.yml. Service `postgres`: image pgvector/pgvector:pg16, container_name docmind-postgres, env POSTGRES_DB=docmind POSTGRES_USER=docmind POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-docmind}, ports 5433:5432 (avoid clashing with any local 5432), volume for data, mount ./db/init into /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d, and a pg_isready healthcheck. Service `doc-service-py`: build ./doc-service-py, container_name docmind-doc-service, ports 8091:8091, env DOCMIND_LOG_LEVEL and DOCMIND_PERSIST_ARTIFACTS=false. Service `api-java`: build ./api-java, container_name docmind-api, ports 8090:8090, depends_on postgres(healthy) + doc-service-py, env_file ./.env, env for SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL (jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/docmind), DB creds, DOC_SERVICE_BASE_URL=http://doc-service-py:8091, GEMINI_API_KEYS=${GEMINI_API_KEYS:-}. Keep the two app build-contexts referring to Dockerfiles created in FEAT-002/003; compose must still pass `docker compose config` now even though those Dockerfiles arrive later (build context dirs exist).
Create docmind/db/init/001_init.sql with `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;` and a short comment that app tables are managed by Flyway in api-java (so init only guarantees the extension).

Create docmind/docs/canonical-schema.md documenting the EXACT contract (see acceptance criteria): Document, Block (with all enum type values and the formula->latex rule), Chunk inheritance, and stats.engine_breakdown. Include one worked JSON example of a Document with 2-3 blocks.

Create docmind/README.md covering: architecture (Java orchestrator vs Python parser, chat is Java-only and never calls Python), how to run via docker compose (ports 8090 api / 8091 doc-service / 5433 postgres), the REST API contract for both services (ingest async job pattern + chat), a pointer to docs/canonical-schema.md, the ingest flow and the chat flow (as ASCII pipelines), the correlation-id/observability model, and explicit notes that MinerU is intentionally DEFERRED until its license is verified and that formula handling targets LaTeX output. Note the Spring Boot 4 / pgvector deviation from the sibling horoscope project.

Create docmind/.env.example (committed) with placeholders following the horoscope convention: POSTGRES_PASSWORD, SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL/USERNAME/PASSWORD, DOC_SERVICE_BASE_URL, GEMINI_API_KEYS (empty by default, with a comment that chat uses a stub LLM until a key is set), DOCMIND_LOG_LEVEL, DOCMIND_PERSIST_ARTIFACTS. Create/extend docmind/.gitignore to ignore .env, Java target/, Python __pycache__/ .venv/ *.pyc, and any artifacts/ debug dir.
Create docmind/db/README.md (one short paragraph) explaining init SQL vs Flyway ownership so later maintainers do not duplicate DDL.
acceptance_criteria: `docker compose -f docmind/docker-compose.yml config` exits 0 and shows services postgres, doc-service-py, api-java with the ports 5433->5432, 8091->8091, 8090->8090 respectively.
docmind/db/init/001_init.sql contains `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;`.

docmind/docs/canonical-schema.md defines Document{document_id,source{filename,sha256,mime,pages},blocks[],stats{engine_breakdown}} and Block{block_id,page,order,type(heading|paragraph|table|formula|key_value|checkbox|image|list),text,markdown,html,latex,bbox[x0,y0,x1,y1],confidence,heading_path[],parse_engine(paddleocr|docling|pymupdf|office),parse_version} with the rule that latex is present only when type=formula, and documents that chunks inherit document_id, heading_path, source block_ids, page, bbox.
docmind/README.md mentions port 8090 (api) and the MinerU-deferred + LaTeX-formula notes, and states the chat path is Java-only.
docmind/.env.example is present and docmind/.gitignore ignores .env and target/.
verification: Run: docker compose -f docmind/docker-compose.yml config  (must exit 0; validates compose + port mappings). If the Docker CLI is unavailable in the environment, state that and instead assert the YAML parses and the required keys/ports are present by reading the file.
Confirm docmind/db/init/001_init.sql, docmind/docs/canonical-schema.md, docmind/README.md, docmind/.env.example, docmind/.gitignore all exist with the content required by the acceptance criteria.
findings: Infra + shared contract + docs landed. `docker compose -f docmind/docker-compose.yml config` exits 0; services postgres (5433->5432), doc-service-py (8091->8091), api-java (8090->8090). NOTE: compose `api-java.env_file: ./.env` means `docker compose config` requires a local docmind/.env to exist — create it via `cp .env.example .env` (it is gitignored, NOT committed). CONTRACT FEAT-002/FEAT-003 MUST MIRROR VERBATIM (docs/canonical-schema.md is source of truth): Document{document_id(UUID string), source{filename,sha256(hex),mime,pages(int)}, blocks[], stats{engine_breakdown: object<engine,int>}}. Block{block_id(UUID),page(1-based int),order(0-based int),type,text,markdown,html,latex,bbox,confidence(0-1 number),heading_path(string[]),parse_engine,parse_version(string)}. type enum EXACT: heading|paragraph|table|formula|key_value|checkbox|image|list. parse_engine enum EXACT: paddleocr|docling|pymupdf|office (MinerU intentionally DEFERRED — NOT a valid value). RULE: latex is non-null string ONLY when type==formula, else null; formula handling targets LaTeX. bbox shape: array[4] of numbers [x0,y0,x1,y1], top-left origin (x0,y0 top-left corner; x1,y1 bottom-right). All keys snake_case; consumers ignore unknown keys. Chunks (built by Java) INHERIT: document_id (from Document), heading_path/page/bbox (from Block), block_ids (array of source Block.block_id); a chunk stays within one page; bbox is the union of its blocks' bboxes. engine_breakdown keys are parse_engine values -> block count. Embedding dim: NOT fixed by FEAT-001 — pgvector `vector` extension is enabled by db/init/001_init.sql but the vector column dimension is decided by api-java's Flyway migration + chosen embedding model (FEAT-003); DB app tables are Flyway-owned, init SQL only guarantees the extension. Env/config: ${ENV_VAR:default} style; committed .env.example, gitignored .env; GEMINI_API_KEYS empty default -> chat uses stub LLM; DOCMIND_LOG_LEVEL / DOCMIND_PERSIST_ARTIFACTS shared by both services. Spring Boot 4.0.0 + Postgres/pgvector/Flyway is the mandated deviation from horoscope (ignore any MySQL/other-SB-version steering for DocMind's datastore).
